completion_rule: Mark work item COMPLETE_STATIC only with material source/artifact evidence and passing appropriate CI. Advance active_work_id to next queued actionable task in the same GitHub commit. Use WAITING_USER_HMD for untestable headset acceptance; never claim all 16 visually complete without proof.
rights: Do not fetch paid or gated assets without permission; no unauthorized redistribution of third-party binaries. Public GitHub contains only patches, scripts, manifests and permissible small evidence; private assets remain outside.
priority_rule: No docs-only loops. First real code/model conversion, changed-area tests, then one exact-SHA end-to-end gate; duplicate SHA repeat forbidden.
no_progress_rule: If source HEAD and queue fingerprint are unchanged across max_unchanged_dispatches, controller holds until GitHub SSOT changes; do not dispatch redundant chats.
